files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
### Changed

- Prefixed localStorage keys with the app id and hardened saved state loading
- Updated keyboard and touch input handling for modern browsers
- Replaced link-like game controls with native buttons
- Removed obsolete JavaScript polyfills
- Switched the navigation icon to a theme-friendly SVG

### Fixed

- Nextcloud 35 supported
- Updated the page controller to use modern Nextcloud attributes
